name: java-default-package-identity
body:
Java sources in the default (empty) package must still receive a stable, reachable module identity. Today `src/javalib/CallGraphBuilder.java` declares no package and `java.CallGraphBuilder.Collector.emitPkgHierarchy` returns early on an empty package, so no module record is emitted, the File's parent is empty and it is orphaned, the top-level class renders with a leading dot (`.CallGraphBuilder`) while its members land under `java.CallGraphBuilder.*`, and no `java` Language root exists — the whole Java subtree is invisible to module-based tools.

Acceptance criteria:
- A `java` Language root exists and Contains the default-package module.
- The top-level class `CallGraphBuilder` has a parent module rather than a leading-dot fqn.
- The File has a non-empty module parent in the graph.
- Module-based tools (e.g. `apg_module_structs`) can enumerate the Java subtree.
